thread:
sara: RFC follow-up — we need a concrete plan for supporting legacy 'envelope' payloads after the v3 switch. Options on the table: gateway shim, tenant sidecar, or push a client polyfill. Short convo to pick a pragmatic path.
ben: Gateway shim is the fastest to implement from infra side, but it touches every request path. Concerned about adding tail latency at p95 during spikes.
michael: Sidecar avoids global routing changes and gives tenant-level control. More infra work per-tenant but isolates blast radius.
ravi: Client polyfill + SDK changes are ideal, but adoption historically lags (see v2->v3 embed migration). Can't rely on it alone.
sara: Do we have perf numbers comparing gateway vs sidecar?
ben: Quick load test numbers from yesterday:
```
gateway shim: +7-12ms p95 under 10k rps peak
sidecar: +1-3ms p95 (network hop dependent)
```
Also gateway increased CPU on api-router by ~4%.
michael: Also consider cost footprint: sidecars mean more containers per-tenant while gateway is a single logical change.
ben: Telemetry gap: transformed requests need a marker so billing & debugs show original shape. Suggest header `x-rw-compat: envelope-v1->v3` and a `compat.transform` meter.
ravi: We must also track token deltas. Wrapping/unwrapping changes token counts and could silently regress costs. Add token-delta histogram.
sara: Proposed short-term plan: implement a feature-flagged gateway shim for emergency coverage (2 weeks), ship SDK polyfill and docs, and start building sidecar as the long-term, opt-in tenant path. Deprecation: 6 months of overlap after gateway ship, with gradual tenant opt-outs.
michael: For rollout, do canary -> 5% -> 25% -> 100% and gate by error rate + token-delta + p95 latency.
deploy-bot: @sara can schedule a canary: /rollout start gateway-shim --tenants=alpha --pct=5 --meta="compat-check"
ben: Add a fallback: if transform fails, route to a compat-model variant (lower-capacity but known-good) and surface a strong alert. Better than returning 500.
ravi: I'll add regression tests: unit tests for envelope transforms, end-to-end with prompt sets that check output shape and token counts. Also add automated eval to detect quality drift.
sara: Docs & comms: I'll draft the migration doc + email to customers and add deprecation header to responses for legacy clients. Wording will emphasize a clear rollback path.
michael: I'll open the proto PR for the gateway shim today, include feature flag and header instrumentation.
ben: Telemetry owners: I'll own the billing tag + dashboards. Will add alert when token-delta > 15% or error-rate > 1% for canary.
ravi: Heads-up: some 3rd-party partners inject envelopes at edge; we'll need migration helpers or a beta sidecar package for them.
sara: Summary of action items:
- michael: gateway shim prototype + PR (feature-flagged)
- ben: telemetry + billing header and alerts
- ravi: regression & token-delta tests + eval sets
- sara: migration doc + deprecation comms
Timeline: prototype + canary in ~2 weeks, SDK polyfill out concurrently, sidecar design doc within a month.
sara: Anything else? :thinking_face:
ben: Consider adding a tenant opt-in CLI to enable sidecar for early adopters.
michael: Also include runbook for rollback and a panic-key to disable transform globally.
sara: Great — thanks all. Will post the plan in the RFC thread and link the PRs. :rocket:
